title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30898v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native laten

translated_title: 世界模型作为原生潜在动作模型
translated_abstract: 大规模且多样的视频源，例如以自我为中心的人类视频和异构机器人录制视频，蕴含丰富的动态信息，但它们要么没有动作标注，要么缺乏共享的动作空间。潜在动作模型（LAM）能够恢复这些动态，但其逆动力学模型和前向动力学模型（IDM、FDM）需要从头训练，并在像素重建与潜在容量及准确性之间进行权衡。预训练的视频世界模型天然能够生成高保真的动态，却以稠密的方式表示这些动态，并在所有层中相互纠缠。通过将世界模型视为一个 LAM，我们证明只需对模型进行极小的改动即可提取出这些动态。Native LAM 让单个预训练的视频扩散 Transformer 同时充当 IDM 和 FDM，仅以可学习的动态寄存器作为两者之间唯一的因果桥梁，并在仅运动存在差异的反事实时间对上进行训练，从而使这些寄存器将视频的动态蒸馏为紧凑的原生潜在表示。
tldr: 该论文提出 Native LAM，将预训练视频世界模型本身用作潜在动作模型，通过可学习的动态寄存器作为因果桥梁并在反事实时间对上训练，以极小的改动从无动作标注的大规模异构视频中提取出紧凑的潜在动作表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Native LAM, which repurposes a pretrained video world model itself as a latent action model, using learnable dynamics registers as the sole causal bridge and counterfactual temporal pairs for training to extract compact latent action representations from large-scale actionless heterogeneous videos with minimal modifications.
